_comment: Single source of workspace-discovery parity cases. The Go resolver test (pkg/workspaceconfig) and the VS Code extension's discovery test both materialize each case and assert their discovery matches the expected anchor and marker here. Adding a case (or a new marker) here updates both sides at once; neither keeps a private copy. Per case: files[] (path + content, or path + dir:true) build a fixture tree; start is the directory discovery runs from (relative to the fixture root); anchor is the expected marker path relative to the fixture root (null when nothing anchors); marker is the wire token the Go resolver reports ("" when no marker — the CWD fallback).
_revision_comment: revision names this case set. Each side pins its OWN copy of the number and refuses a fixture declaring a different one, so a green from a side is evidence that side READ this revision — not merely that it agreed with the other. Change a case, add one, or remove one, and bump revision: both sides then refuse until each side's own pinned copy is moved, which cannot be done without running both. That is the whole mechanism — a pair that only asserts agreement is green when one side never executed, because a comparison nothing performed reports nothing.

cases.name: bare config (no workspace: block) does not anchor
aggregate suffixed glob anchors the root
